subtitle: Discipline at Dawn in Nalanda’s City of Learning

panels.shot: wide aerial view of Nalanda at daybreak
panels.action: From above, the vast brick complex of Nalanda glows under a pale dawn sky, monks in saffron and dull red robes moving like small streams toward central courtyards, while Yijing stands at the edge, gazing at the awakening monastery-city.

dialogue.text: In Nalanda of the seventh century, as dawn bells stirred thousands of monks, Yijing watched and asked: how can a vast city of seekers live by one shared discipline?

i18n.hi: सातवीं सदी के नालंदा में, सुबह की घंटियाँ हज़ारों भिक्षुओं को जगाती हैं। ईजिंग सोचता है: इतने साधकों का शहर एक जैसे नियमों से कैसे चलता है?

panels.shot: slow push-in from darkness to Yijing’s contemplative face
panels.action: In a dim cell lit by the first grey of dawn, Yijing sits cross-legged on a simple bed, his travel-worn face turned toward the open doorway where faint light and a distant bell seem to beckon.

dialogue.text: From far Tang China, Yijing had sailed and ridden for years to reach Nalanda. Now, before sunrise, he hears a soft bell. It is the pulse of this disciplined world.

i18n.hi: दूर तांग चीन से, ईजिंग सालों जहाज़ और घोड़े पर सफर कर नालंदा पहुँचा। अब सूर्योदय से पहले, वह हल्की घंटी सुनता है। यही इस अनुशासित दुनिया की धड़कन है।

panels.shot: medium shot from behind Yijing looking into the corridor
panels.action: Yijing kneels at his cell doorway, looking into a long brick corridor where shadowy figures of monks quietly rise, adjust their robes, and turn toward the courtyard as the morning bell grows clearer.

dialogue.text: He had read of Vinaya rules in texts. Here he sees them as footsteps in a corridor, as the bell draws every monk, young and old, into one shared rhythm.

i18n.hi: वह विनय के नियम किताबों में पढ़ चुका था। यहाँ वह उन्हें देखता है: गलियारे में कदमों की चाल में, जैसे घंटी हर युवा और वृद्ध भिक्षु को एक लय में बाँध रही हो।

panels.action: In a broad inner courtyard framed by monks’ cells, lines of monks move with measured steps, some carrying small cloth bundles and water pots, while Yijing stands to one side, observing with intent, a palm-leaf manuscript held loosely in his hand.

dialogue.text: In his record, Yijing would note: at dawn, the monks rise, dress properly, and move in order. Nalanda is not a crowd; it is a community shaped by rule.

i18n.hi: अपनी किताब में ईजिंग लिखेगा: भोर में भिक्षु उठते हैं, ठीक से वस्त्र पहनते हैं, कतार से चलते हैं। नालंदा भीड़ नहीं, नियमों से घड़ी हुई एक संगति है।

panels.shot: wide shot of bathing pools, side-on
panels.action: Beyond the main buildings, rectangular masonry pools lie still under the morning light; monks descend stone steps calmly, some already pouring water over themselves, while Yijing stands at the edge, watching the ritual of bathing.

dialogue.text: Later he writes: before study, the monks bathe in appointed pools. Cleanliness is not a luxury here. It is the first discipline of the day.

i18n.hi: बाद में वह लिखता है: पढ़ाई से पहले भिक्षु तय तालाबों में स्नान करते हैं। यहाँ स्वच्छता ऐश नहीं, दिन का पहला अनुशासन है।

panels.shot: closer shot of the pool, focus on rules in action
panels.action: Monks at the pool keep respectful distance, each using water sparingly and silently; one older monk gestures a younger one to adjust his robe properly, as Yijing quietly notes these small corrections.

dialogue.speaker: yijing
dialogue.text: Every gesture is guided. Thousands can bathe without chaos.

i18n.hi: हर हरकत पर नियम की नज़र है। हज़ारों लोग भी बिना हुड़दंग के स्नान कर लेते हैं।

panels.shot: medium shot inside a simple refectory hall
panels.action: In a long refectory, rows of monks sit on low platforms before simple bowls, waiting with hands folded as servers stand ready with ladles; Yijing sits among them, watching how no one eats before a signal.

dialogue.text: Yijing’s account tells of dining rules: monks sit in order, wait together, and eat only after a sign. Food becomes part of training, not private habit.

i18n.hi: ईजिंग बताता है खाने के नियम: भिक्षु क्रम से बैठते हैं, साथ इंतज़ार करते हैं, इशारे के बाद ही खाते हैं। भोजन भी साधना है, निजी आदत नहीं।

panels.shot: close-up on Yijing recording on a palm-leaf manuscript
panels.action: Back in his cell, Yijing leans over a palm-leaf strip, stylus poised, his eyes focused and calm, writing neat characters as the faint sound of another bell drifts in from outside.

dialogue.text: His stylus moves and the dawn becomes ink. He sets down: robes of prescribed colours, rules for washing, for sitting, for walking. Nalanda’s order is made visible in words.

i18n.hi: उसकी लेखनी चलती है, भोर स्याही बन जाती है। वह लिखता जाता है: तय रंग के वस्त्र, धोने के नियम, बैठने के, चलने के। नालंदा का अनुशासन शब्दों में दिखाई देने लगता है।

panels.shot: wide shot of lecture hall filled with monks
panels.action: In a spacious brick and timber lecture hall, hundreds of monks sit in ranked rows, some from different regions, their faces turned toward an elderly teacher at the front, while Yijing watches attentively from the side.

dialogue.text: Xuanzang had praised Nalanda’s halls of debate. Yijing now records the daily discipline that fills those halls: only those who keep the rules may sit and study here.

i18n.hi: श्वेनज़ांग ने नालंदा की वाद-विवाद सभा की तारीफ की थी। अब ईजिंग यहाँ की रोज़मर्रा की सख्ती दर्ज कर रहा है: जो नियम निभाए, वही यहाँ बैठकर पढ़ सकता है।

panels.shot: medium shot of a senior Indian monk speaking with Yijing
panels.action: In a shaded veranda, a senior Indian monk speaks calmly to Yijing, gesturing toward the vast complex as younger monks pass by in orderly pairs, their steps measured.

dialogue.text: He learns of the Nalanda Nikaya, a body of discipline that governs life here. This is not the rule of one man, but of an agreed code handed down and applied.

i18n.hi: वह नालंदा निकाय के बारे में जानता है, अनुशासन का वह निकाय जो यहाँ का जीवन चलाता है। यह किसी एक आदमी की हुकूमत नहीं, मिलकर बनाई और निभाई गई संहिता है।

panels.shot: close-up on Yijing’s thoughtful face, side-lit
panels.action: Yijing sits alone under an archway, watching a line of monks pass like a quiet river, his brow slightly furrowed as he weighs what he sees against the Vinaya texts he knows.

dialogue.text: In his travelogue, he carefully compares Indian practice with Chinese customs. Some habits differ, but the heart is the same: shared rules that allow many to live and learn together.

i18n.hi: अपने यात्रा-वृत्तांत में वह भारतीय तरीकों की तुलना चीनी रिवाजों से सावधानी से करता है। आदतें बदलती हैं, पर दिल एक है: साझा नियम, जिनसे कई लोग साथ रहकर सीख सकें।

panels.shot: wide shot showing diversity of monks in the courtyard
panels.action: The courtyard is now bright with sun; monks of varied features and dress—the signs of origins from different regions—cross paths peacefully, moving along set routes, while Yijing stands at the center, surrounded yet not jostled.

dialogue.text: Yijing notes that monks here come from many lands. Nalanda’s discipline binds strangers into fellow students. Without it, distance and number would pull them apart.

i18n.hi: ईजिंग लिखता है कि यहाँ के भिक्षु कई देशों से आते हैं। नालंदा का अनुशासन अजनबियों को सहपाठी बना देता है। बिना नियमों के दूरी और संख्या उन्हें अलग कर देती।

panels.shot: medium shot of Yijing offering guidance to a younger foreign monk
panels.action: Under a tree, Yijing gently speaks to a young foreign monk, pointing toward the bathing pools and refectory, the younger monk listening earnestly, mimicking the careful fold of Yijing’s robe.

dialogue.speaker: yijing
dialogue.text: Follow their rules closely. Then the teachings will open to you.

i18n.hi: उनके नियम पूरे मन से मानो। तभी शिक्षाएँ तुम्हारे लिए खुलेंगी।

panels.shot: slow pull-back from Yijing writing in a quiet chamber
panels.action: In a secluded chamber stacked with palm-leaf bundles, Yijing sits surrounded by manuscripts, continuing to write his account of Indian monastic discipline, the chamber’s doorway framing a distant glimpse of the bustling courtyard.

dialogue.text: Years later, his work would carry Nalanda’s daily rules back to East Asia. The bells he hears at dawn in Bihar will echo in monasteries across the seas.

i18n.hi: सालों बाद, उसका लेख नालंदा के दैनिक नियमों को फिर पूर्वी एशिया तक ले जाएगा। बिहार की ये सुबह की घंटियाँ सागर पार मठों में गूँजेंगी।

panels.shot: evening wide shot of Nalanda courtyard from high angle
panels.action: At dusk, the same courtyard is bathed in warm light; monks return in orderly lines to their cells, the pools now still and empty, as Yijing stands quietly, watching the day’s discipline fold back into silence.

dialogue.text: Modern scholars use Yijing’s careful notes to glimpse Nalanda as a working institution: a residential city whose strength lay not only in ideas, but in the rules that carried them.

i18n.hi: आज के विद्वान ईजिंग की बारीक नोटों से नालंदा को काम करती संस्था की तरह देखते हैं: एक आवासीय नगर, जिसकी ताकत सिर्फ विचारों में नहीं, उन नियमों में थी जो उन्हें टिकाते थे।

panels.shot: close-up on Yijing looking up toward the bell tower in twilight
panels.action: In the deepening twilight, Yijing looks up at a simple structure from which a monk bell-ringer prepares the next chime, his expression calm yet intent, as if listening beyond the sound to its meaning.

dialogue.text: For Yijing, the morning bell at Nalanda is more than a sound. It is the sign that discipline can turn thousands of separate lives into one shared path of learning.

i18n.hi: ईजिंग के लिए नालंदा की सुबह की घंटी सिर्फ आवाज़ नहीं। यह निशानी है कि अनुशासन हज़ारों अलग ज़िंदगियों को एक साझा सीखने की राह में बदल सकता है।

subtitle_i18n.en: Discipline at Dawn in Nalanda’s City of Learning
